paragraphs: He is mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 12:5; Hyman reports the reading R' Ilam in Eichah Rabbah 2:12.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman reports the Ilam reading at the supplied Eichah Rabbah2:12 locator beside the heading Hillel bar Hilni and the Vayikra Rabbah12:5 reference. No named passage for either of those two locators was supplied in the earlier review or freshly collated here. The heading and reported variant therefore retain the source’s abbreviated title as R'. The names and locators are preserved without establishing an alias, paternal identity, fuller title or printed correction history. Earlier English and model judgments remain archived.
